summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for automated bot reviews (CodeRabbit, Copilot), automatically resolve them, collect staging performance baselines for the vault login path, and fix a session restore race condition discovered during the process.
summary.outcome: All 23 review threads on PR #349 resolved across 4 rounds with 3 real bugs fixed; staging perf baselines captured; session restore race condition fixed in PR #350 and merged; desktop E2E vault init race fixed in PR #351.

repo: The cipher-box project is at FSM1/cipher-box and uses a pnpm monorepo with apps/web, apps/desktop (Tauri/Rust), apps/api (NestJS), and packages/core.

IPNS publish endpoint (ipns.service.ts) creates folder_ipns rows on first publish; vault.service.ts initializeVault also tried to insert the same row — causing a duplicate key constraint when publish preceded init (PR #349 ordering change).
VaultBlobV2 type was removed; functions now return Uint8Array directly. METADATA_SCHEMAS.md had stale references.
Web3Auth Core Kit DKG on Sapphire Devnet dominates login time (~9-45s); cipher-box vault-critical path is <1.5s serial.

The Axios 401 interceptor in packages/api-client/src/instance.ts already deduplicates token refreshes triggered by 401s, but direct authApi.refresh() calls in session restore effects are NOT deduplicated by that interceptor.
E2E tests use @johanneskares/wallet-mock with installMockWallet() for wallet login simulation with real secp256k1 signing.
GSD todos live in .planning/todos/pending/ and .planning/todos/done/; perf baselines in .planning/perf/.
Desktop E2E skip-on-no-changes means a passing desktop CI run may mask regressions from other PRs.

code.finding: Broad try/catch around entire vault load block caused IPFS 404 errors (missing CID) to be misclassified as new-user flows, triggering vault re-initialization for existing users.
Module-level vaultInitPromise deduplication guard prevents concurrent React effect cycles from racing on vault init — same shared-Promise pattern used for auth refresh.
authApi.refresh() needed its own in-flight Promise deduplication; page reload triggers multiple React effects that all call it directly (not via 401 interceptor path).
Recovery script reused vault key IPNS name for root folder traversal — needed to derive both IPNS keypairs separately.
initializeVault inserted a folder_ipns row without checking if the publish endpoint already created it; fixed with try/catch on QueryFailedError (unique constraint) to update isRoot instead.
slice() was used where subarray() is appropriate for zero-copy Uint8Array views.

workflow: The /loop skill + CronCreate enables automated PR monitoring: cron fires every 5 minutes, checks for unresolved bot review threads, and triggers /resolve-pr-reviews automatically.
Outside-diff-range review comments don't appear as reviewThreads in GraphQL; must be fetched via the REST reviews endpoint and handled separately.
Playwright MCP browser_run_code sandbox doesn't support Node module imports; standalone .mjs scripts run via Bash are more reliable for custom Playwright automation.
Native Playwright page.on('request'/'response') events are more reliable than injected fetch monitoring that doesn't survive navigations.
markdownlint runs in CI on all files; prettier also runs on all files not just staged — both must pass before merge.
Pre-existing TypeScript spec file errors in CI should be verified against main before assuming a change caused them.

friction: GitHub API timed out on one cron check — transient network issue, no retry logic in the cron prompt.
Outside-diff-range Copilot comments don't surface as unresolved review threads in GraphQL, requiring manual intervention to discover and address them.
1Password SSH agent unavailable during a Bash commit attempt, requiring user to retry.
Playwright MCP browser_run_code cannot import Node modules (playwright, @johanneskares/wallet-mock), forcing a fallback to standalone .mjs scripts via Bash.
Web3Auth OTP on staging is a real OTP — can't be bypassed for wallet login testing; required the mock wallet injection approach.
Staging DB was wiped, so no existing vaults were available for real IPNS resolve/fetch baseline measurements initially.
Core Kit session state doesn't persist across Playwright page reloads in the scripted perf measurement context, preventing true session restore baseline capture.
Desktop E2E tests are skipped when no desktop files change, masking regressions introduced by API or shared package changes.
open_items: vault.service.ts initializeVault is not wrapped in a database transaction — the existingVault check and subsequent inserts are non-atomic, leaving a theoretical race window even after the folder_ipns fix.
Real IPNS resolve + IPFS fetch latency baseline for an existing v2 vault blob not yet captured (staging had no live vault at measurement time); needs re-measurement post-deploy.

Session restore scenario baseline is incomplete — Core Kit tKey shares don't persist across Playwright reloads, so true warm-session-restore timing (tab reopen within session lifetime) was not measured.

Auth/refresh race condition todo is marked done after the fix, but the fix should be validated by re-running the E2E session restore test specifically and confirming the 6-concurrent-call pattern no longer occurs.
Desktop E2E skip-on-no-changes behavior means API regressions from non-desktop PRs can silently break desktop tests until manually triggered — consider forcing desktop E2E on API changes.
